commit.message:
Refactor updater logic and add support for V2.4.0+ hardware

- Hardware Support: Added logic to distinguish between ESP32 V2 legacy (PICO-D4) and V2.4.0+ (PICO-V3-02) hardware revisions.

-User Experience: Implemented manual hardware selection prompts for "empty" devices without a stored version string.

Adjust task stack sizes

Add OTA update library to scanner firmware.

Bump esp_littlefs version from 1.8.0 to 1.14.8
Bump littlefs version from 2.7.0 to 2.9.3

Modify partition table to include app1 ota partition for future wireless firmware update.

Rename partition_table.bin to partitions.bin.
Add EATX4/4A option to bootloader lists

Improve bus transceiver behavior

So far bus interrupts were firing regardless of on/off state. This may have interfered with SCI-bus operations while flashing a controller in-vehicle.

Now bus interrupts are properly disabled.
Add cancellation feature for bootstrap operations

Fix SCI-bus setting parser

OBD configuration (A/B) was not updated upon receiving SCI-bus settings packet.

OBD1 backward compatibility for V2.1.0 scanners

V2.1.0 scanners were sold with external SCI-bus logic inverter built into adapter cables.

V2.2.0 scanners deal with inverted SCI-bus logic internally and use simpler adapter cables.

GUI bootstrap feature now ignores CCD/PCI-bus messages when scanner is used in-vehicle. PCM might be down but other modules still talk over these buses.
Allow Flash/EEPROM file reuse in scanner's internal storage

Update to latest GUI version for V1 hardware

Latest stable GUI version for V1 hardware is v0.14.4.

Fix EEPROM restore feature

PCM unlocking is done by the scanner firmware.

Fix OBD2 EEPROM write unlock bug

Unlock key was never sent after requesting seed.

Improve SCI-bus logic settings

It is now possible to select 4 different SCI-bus logic:
- inverted logic + 4-bit switch around: OBD1 SBEC
- inverted logic: OBD1 JTEC
- non-inverted logic: OBD2
- non-inverted logic w/ SCI-II: OBD2 NGC

Improve JTEC bootloaders and SCI-bus timeout

More timeout is needed for SCI-bus messages when dealing with JTEC unit's external EEPROM writing.

Fix baudrate select bug in GUI

Do not change baudrate setting after connection.

Add selectable baudrate for USB comm

New GUI menu:
Settings / UART baudrate

Supported baudrates:
- 250000, non-standard default,
- 115200, standard.

GUI restart is required after changing baudrate.

Improve USB packet handler

Change autoscale mode to DPI
Change form border styles to sizable

Add GUI localization and Cummins engine tools

Add Spanish language.
Add support for Cummins ECM SCI-bus commands.
All beta.

Add EATX3 bootloader

Basic support for Transmission Control Module (TCM) in bootstrap mode.

Add Demo mode to GUI

Explore features without scanner.

Fix PCM configuration response handler

Reduce expected message length to 3 bytes, as the last FE byte is not echoed by JTEC units.
Fix PCI CC outside air temperature scaling

Fix cruise and temperature message scaling

PCI 1A message has set cruise speed in raw km/h units. Ambient temperature offset is only 40 units (same as in PCI C0 message).

Improve flash ID bootstrap worker function

Flash ID function now returns the first 4 bytes read in electronic signature mode.

Fix bootstrap flash erase error

Removed too much timeout.

JTEC bootstrap and other small hotfixes

Keep avoiding JTEC EEPROM tasks until worker function is developed.

Add DTC freeze frame feature and other hotfixes

Freeze frame associated with a fault code is now available to read via Tools / Engine tools menu.

Only 1 freeze frame exist.
A DTC with higher priority level overwrites the lower priority frame.
Snapshot contains 15 PIDs. Not much but good for starters.

SCI ID 11 is now recognized as the command to read pending fault codes. Last 2 fault codes are queued here before moving them to permanent storage (SCI ID 10).

SCI ID 2E is included in the fault code retrieval process. It returns one-trip fault codes in SCI ID 10 style.

Various hotfixes

Add transmission fan relay state to CCD/PCI message handlers.
Add SCI 13 45, 13 47, 13 50, 13 51 actuator test mode descriptions.
Add SCI F4 61 message description.
Fix PCI EA transmission temperature scaling

Add Teves/ATE ABS MK4-G and MK20 features

Features implemented:
- read ABS ID,
- read fault codes,
- erase fault codes.

Future features:
- read wheel speeds,
- read sensors,
- actuator tests.

Fix cruise set speed scaling

All cruise set speed values heard across CCD/PCI/SCI-buses are scaled down the same half amount.

Add JTEC 256k bootloader

Add placeholder ABS tools menu. Tweak things here and there.

Fix PCI-bus message conversion, simplify code

Add JTEC bootloader option to Bootstrap tools menu. Bootloader itself is to be added to scanner firmware in next update.

Add TMS28F210 flash chip support

Also added new data logging feature to Engine tools that saves diagnostic data requests to a CSV-file.

Improve SCI-bus speed change in bootstrap mode

SCI-bus speed is set back to 7812.5 baud after finishing a bootstrap session.

Add memory backup option

Flash memory and EEPROM backup is now optional, speeding up flash write sessions.

SCI-bus speed is set back to 7812.5 baud after bootstrap session ends.

Improve entering SCI-bus bootstrap mode

Wait at least 10 seconds after turning key to OFF position.

Improve part number analyzer

Earlier part numbers don't have a double letter appended as revision indicator (AA, AB...), instead 99 is used.

Add SCI ID 14 PIDs for intake air temperature, fuel system status, Cam/Crank sync status.
Fix progress display in bootstrap mode

Add SBEC3 re-programming tools and engine tools

The "Tools / Bootstrap tools" menu now features a complete SBEC3 re-programming solution. It makes backups of the current flash memory and EEPROM content. Supports common 128k and 256k flash memories.

The "Tools / Engine tools" menu features important tools to aid navigation in the multitude of SCI-bus PIDs. Applies to SBEC2/SBEC3/JTEC units. To be expanded.

Add new worker function IDs

Rename "flash program" to "flash write". Change worker function order. Use timestamp setting directly from Properties.Settings.Default.

Improve updater methods

Prepare SCI-bus NGC mode support. Add PCI-bus handler methods for future v2 hardware.
Add flash memory erase worker function

Rename GUI

GUI renamed due to added PCI-bus message handling capability. Instead of Chrysler CCD/PCI/SCI Scanner, which is a mouthful, Chrysler Scanner it is.
